glosses: motorway (Britain, Ireland, New Zealand), freeway (Australia, Canada, US), highway (parts of the US), expressway (parts of Canada, parts of the US), controlled-access highway

examples.text: Der Unfall geschah auf der Autobahn.
examples.en: The accident took place on the highway.

examples.text: Diese Autobahn spart uns eine Menge Zeit.
examples.en: This highway saves us a lot of time.

examples.text: Die neue Autobahn soll 9,24 Millionen Dollar kosten.
examples.en: The new highway is expected to cost 9.24 million dollars.

examples.text: Es ist Stau auf der Autobahn.
examples.en: There's a traffic jam on the highway.
